headline: Possible new working group on invasive species management, plus lawn rewilding updates and a Join Fair recap.
summary: A call to form an invasive species working group is listed for action. The Winooski Natural Resources Conservation District wants to form a CISMA in Chittenden County for invasive species management.
items: Lawn rewilding working group update and questions
Invasive species management: call to form a working group

as their role?
